name: Bayardo Alexis Silva Membreño
headline: Founder & CEO at Alchemie | Netsuite Consulting Expert
about:
Contribute to efficiency of the businesses through information technology.

Participate in NetSuite customization projects, as administrator, designer, programmer and support.
- Leader of the development team.
- Research and implement development best practices.
- Customer support during implementation and post implementation.
- Business requirement analysis.
- Develop flexible.
- Design and development requirement in México, Electronic Invoicing "CFDI 3.3
- Design and development integration with: Commerzia, Teamwork Retail, and other custom
apps.
- Integrate Netsuite with 3r d party applications using SOAP and JSON WebServices.
- Use Netsuite SuiteScript 1.0 and SuiteScript 2.0 to create applications
- Design and development requirement in USA
- Design and development requirement in Spain

Depending of requirements, the following SuiteCloud Developer Tools were used: 
- Custom Fields
- Custom Records
- Mass Update
- Saved Search
- Advanced PDF/ HTML Templates 
- CSV Import
- Error handling and debugging
- Workflows
- SuiteScripts (Api 1.0 and 2.0): Cliente, User Event, Suitelet, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Portlets, Restlets Scripts.

… more
